svg.text: Final wiring diagram - Smart Bathroom Light & Fan Controller (GD32F103C8T6)
Feeds the board 5V pin (or the board USB).
VERIFY: OUT must be 3.3 V or less
3V3 only if board has no other power
10 kΩ pull to OFF level on IN1/IN2
if the module has none (design doc)
3 mm LEDs outside the box, GPIO > 330 Ω > LED > GND
Phase L / Neutral N / Earth PE
Earth (PE): connect to the lamp and fan body per local rules
Relay contacts are the screw terminals on the same
relay module: they are shown here on the mains side.
Insulated enclosure, strain relief, correct clearances.
No mains on breadboards or loose wires.
Only the PHASE is switched by the relays.
Keep low-voltage wires apart from 230 V wires.
A qualified electrician must install or inspect.
Tags with the same name are joined: GND = the common ground of every part, 5V = the 5 V supply and board 5V pin, 3V3 = the board 3V3 pin.
Dashed boxes and dashed wires are optional parts. Yellow notes must be verified before power-up. Wire routes are schematic, not physical layout.
Pin positions on the board: see docs/img/pinout.svg. Settings and options: include/config.h.
